content: Abhaniibhi abhasɨɨgʉ
Imwɨ abhaniibhi, munyiitegeerere bhwaheene! Mʉrɨrɨ na kwarama kwiraka ikʉrʉ, igʉrʉ wɨ ɨnyaakʉ ɨkʉrʉ yɨnʉ ɨkʉbhaazaku.
Ubhuniibhi bhwanyu bhʉbhʉrirɨ, na amiibhoho gaanyu gariirwɨ nu umuswa.
Ɨzahaabhu yanyu na zimpirya, zɨrabha zɨkɨrɨbhirɨ, nʉ ʉbhʉkɨrɨbhi bhuyo bhʉrabhamenyeekererya, bhʉrarya ɨmɨbhɨrɨ janyu ncho omorero. Na mwitɨɨrɨɨrɨ ibhibhumbikʉ kuzisikʉ zɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ ziyo.

Mwitegeerere, abhahocha bhaanyu bhararɨrɨɨrɨra! Bhakabhakorera emeremo mʉmɨgʉndʉ janyu, nawe mʉtaabharihirɨ. Na bhayo bhakabhagesera ibhyakurya, bhʉʉsi bhakarɨrɨɨrɨra, nɨ ɨkɨrɨrʉ chabhʉ chigwirwɨ mʉmatwɨ gʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wʉ Ʉbhʉnaja Bhwʉsi.
Mwikɨɨrɨ na kozomererwa ubhuniibhi bhwanyu kʉʉsɨ hanʉ, kwa kʉtama komenya kʉbha Mungu arabhatɨnɨra na kwinenehya nchu umutugʉ gʉnʉ gukuja kusinzwa.
Mutiniirɨ na kwita we eheene wʉnʉ atabhahakaniryɨ imwɨ.
Mwigumiriryɨ ku kuuza kʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu

Mmbe abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mwigumiriryɨ kuhika ribhaga ryʉ ʉkʉgarʉka kʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ. Rora umurimi chɨmbu ahiigumirirya, kʉrɨnda ibhyakurya bhyazɨ bhebhone imbura ye embere na yɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ, neho abhone ibhyakurya ɨbhɨzʉmu bhyu ubhwera.
Kwɨbhu na niimwɨ mwigumiriryɨ, na mʉnajɨ zekoro zaanyu, kʉ kʉbha ʉkʉgarʉka kʉMʉkʉrʉ kʉrɨ haguhɨ.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mutiibheerya imubheene kobheene mʉtaaza kutinirwa. Morore! Umutiniri arɨ haguhɨ kuuza.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mʉbhaangarɨrɨ abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhanʉ bhaarɨ bharagamba kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, bhabhɨ ebherenjo bhyu ubhwigumirirya mʉmabhɨ.
Na bhanʉ bhiigumiriiryɨ, tʉrabharora bhanʉ ʉrʉbhangʉ. Mwigwirɨ amangʼana gu ubhwigumirirya bhwa Ayubhu, na mwɨzɨ chɨmbu Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aamʉkʉrɨɨrɨ amazʉmu mʉtɨnɨrʉ.
Gayo gʉʉsi nɨ‑kʉ kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ izwirɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi nʉ ʉrʉbhangʉ.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, kʉkɨra gayo, mutiirahɨra risaarʉ, ɨɨsɨ ne ekegero chʉchʉsi kirya. Arɨɨbhɨ muriisirirya “Hee,” ɨbhɨ amaheeneheene, arɨɨbhɨ mʉraanga “Zɨyi,” ɨbhɨ maheene zɨyi, korereke mʉtatinirwa.
Mʉsabhɨ Mungu kubhwisirirya
Kʉna mʉʉtʉ kʉbhaniimwɨ wʉnʉ akʉnyaaka? Areenderwa asabhɨ Mungu. Areho wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ ano obhozomerwa? Ereenderwa ɨmbɨ amɨɨmbʉ gu ukukumya.
Kunu umurwɨrɨ gatɨ waanyu? Areenderwa abhabhɨrɨkɨrɨ abhiimiiririri bha risengerero, bhaazɨ kʉmʉsabhɨra ɨwaazɨ na kʉmʉhaka amaguta kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.
Bharɨɨsabhɨ kubhwisirirya umurwɨrɨ arahora, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aramogororocha. Angabha asariryɨ, arabheererwa.
Mmbe, mutigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwanyu imubheene kobheene na kwisabhɨra kwa Mungu, korereke mʉhʉribhwɨ amarwɨrɨ gaanyu. Amasabhi gʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ we eheene ganʉ ʉbhʉnaja na garakora emeremo.
Ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Ɨɨriya, aarɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wi isimʉka nchi iyɨɨtʉ, na akasabha kwa mucha imbura ɨtatweka kʉʉsɨ, ni imbura ɨtaatwɨkirɨ imyaka ɨtatʉ ni imyɨri ɨsaasabha.
Neho naatu, akasabha Mungu imbura itweke, yʉʉsi ɨkatweka kuhika hanʉ ɨɨsɨ yaamɨrirɨ ibhyakurya.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, wʉmwɨ waanyu araahabhɨ na kʉbha kore na amaheene, nʉ ʉwʉndɨ amʉgaruchɨ naatu kʉnzɨra ya amaheene,
momenye wʉnʉ araagaruchɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo kurwa mʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ, arabha amʉhʉriryɨ ekoro yaazɨ kurwa muruku, nʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ bhwaru bhʉrabheererwa.
